data.name: Fareena
data.gender_notes: Fareena is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fareena means 'light' or 'free'. This name has a spiritual connotation, as it is derived from the Arabic word 'far' which means 'to let go' or 'to release'. It is a beautiful name for a girl, symbolizing the freedom and lightness of the soul. The name Fareena carries the meaning “Light, Free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fareena usually hope their child will grow to embody light, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Fareena belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Free.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fareena total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

historical_references.reference: Fareena was the name of a famous Persian princess who lived during the Sassanid Empire (224-651 AD). She is best known for her beauty and her tragic love story with the Arab poet Imru' al-Qais.

Another Fareena is mentioned in the historical records of the Umayyad Caliphate (661-750 AD). She was the wife of Caliph Marwan II and played a significant role in the Battle of Marj Rahit (734 AD), where she rallied the troops to victory against the forces of the Umayyad rival Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik.
